rationale.conceptual: The method involves setting up a QM/MM cluster with a two-layer ONIOM scheme, performing geometry optimizations and transition state searches at a specific DFT level, and adding empirical dispersion corrections. This requires substantial understanding of computational chemistry, basis sets, and the zeolite MFI structure. It is not a simple off-the-shelf method but an established, non-trivial protocol.

The workflow involves several interacting tools and a careful multi-step orchestration.
